summary: After nearly four months out, workers go back to a deal near the employer's opening offer with one big concession won.
realLife: At a Mott's apple sauce plant near Rochester, New York, a 2010 strike ended after about four months with the pension freeze dropped but cuts to the 401(k) match and more health-care cost.
sources: PBS NewsHour, Update: Mott's strike settled: https://www.pbs.org/newshour/economy/update-motts-strike-settled
inGame: a strike formed by the public-action engine ends; job records of strikers continue with new pay and benefits; lost months of pay in the households.

turns.summary: Workers say the pension freeze was the one that mattered.
Workers feel the months out bought little.
turns.writesBack: mood: bitter; trust in the boss lower

turns.summary: Local shops see weak sales while workers are out.
